title: Metadata extract mode
description: System-wide setting for the metadata extraction pipeline after OCR merge. Every dossier follows the selected mode.

modeHelp.old: After merge, the system publishes to merge-completed (legacy metadata worker).
modeHelp.tt05: After merge, the system publishes to start-metadata-tt05 (TT05 worker).
modeHelp.off: After merge, only the database is updated — no Kafka. Trigger manually via the extract API.

errors.loadFailed: Failed to load metadata extract settings

readOnlyHint: You have read-only access. Update permission is required to change the mode.
